budget_items.what_was_recorded: The final FY27 state budget added Chapter 70, charter tuition reimbursement and Smart Growth reimbursement above the Governor's initial proposal.
budget_items.quote: the final fy27 state budget provides an additional $135,915 in chapter 70 funding, $116,413 in charter tuition reimbursement

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The overall increase in Cherry Sheet receipts for FY27 was reported.
budget_items.quote: the overall increase in cherry sheet receipts was $491,988.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: School Choice sending tuition decreased while charter tuition increased, adding state assessments for FY27.
budget_items.quote: resulting in an additional $15,326 in education-related state assessments

budget_items.topic: Net increase in state aid to the Town
budget_items.what_was_recorded: After subtracting increased assessments from increased receipts, the Town's net state aid increase was reported.
budget_items.quote: after subtracting those increased assessments from the additional cherry sheet receipts, the town will receive a net increase of $476,662 in state aid.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The prior budget reconciliation returned money estimated at about 2.5% of the budget; the current year-end position was expected to be well below that.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrants for the period totaled the amount printed.
budget_items.quote: warrants for the period of july 6 through july 20, 2026, totaled $100,507.91.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: LEAF raised more than the printed amount and awarded grants totaling the printed amount across six projects.
budget_items.quote: leaf raised more than $10,000 to support programs and resources for lunenburg public schools and awarded grants totaling $10,716.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two donations to the music programs were presented: one for Color Guard uniforms and one for the Middle School Jazz Band stipend.
budget_items.quote: a $300 donation was provided for the color guard to assist with additional uniforms and related needs

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The District secured FY27 earmark funding for system infrastructure upgrades; a spending plan will be developed.
budget_items.quote: the district also secured $175,000 in fy27 earmark funding for system infrastructure upgrades and will develop a spending plan

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Updated Title II, Title IV and Title I allocations were reported; Title I was well above the amount anticipated.
budget_items.quote: updated federal grant allocations include $28,443 in title ii funding, $15,109 in title iv funding and $193,820 in title i funding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The District will buy the helmets itself because helmets are required safety equipment; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: the district will therefore purchase the additional helmets, and the boosters' proposed helmet donation was withdrawn.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Boosters will fund one-way transportation for the football team and cheerleaders in three donations at an anticipated cost of about the printed amount.
budget_items.quote: the boosters have sufficient funds to cover the anticipated cost of approximately $3,100 and intend to provide one-way transportation

budget_items.topic: FY27 School Department budget increase request
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The warrant article request was raised from the earlier figure to the restated figure, reflecting additional state education receipts; the School Department had reduced its budget by more than the printed amount.
budget_items.quote: increasing the fy27 school department operating budget request from $350,000 to $418,056
